name: LUKO FD-D210K / FD-D320K
subtitle: Compact desiccant rotor dehumidifier, single-phase
bullets: Runs on 220 V / 50 Hz single-phase power

capacity.text: 0.6–1.2 kg/h at 20 °C, 60% RH; 210–320 m³/h process air

overview: The LUKO FD-D210K and FD-D320K are compact desiccant rotor dehumidifiers for small rooms that must stay dry whatever the outdoor weather. A silica gel honeycomb rotor pulls moisture out of the air continuously, so humidity can be held low even at cool room temperatures where a refrigerant dryer struggles. They run on ordinary single-phase power and fit neatly into stores, labs and small production rooms. Cosmix Engineering supplies, installs and supports LUKO dehumidifiers across Pakistan.

features.title: Honeycomb silica gel rotor
features.text: The honeycomb rotor is made of ceramic fibre and active silica gel. Moisture is adsorbed in the process sector while hot air regenerates the rotor, continuously and at the same time, with positive sealing between the two airstreams.

features.title: Plug-in single-phase power
features.text: Both models run on 220 V / 50 Hz, so they suit small rooms without a three-phase supply.

features.title: PTC heating
features.text: Regeneration air is heated by PTC elements for steady, safe rotor reactivation.

features.title: Touch screen and RS485
features.text: A touch screen controller is standard, with RS485 communication for linking to a building management system.

features.title: Robust steel cabinet
features.text: A cold-rolled steel frame with G4 filtration on both the process and regeneration air.

features.title: Where it fits
features.text: Small archives, pharmacy and lab stores, electronics rooms and small production rooms that need a low, stable humidity.

name: LUKO FD-X/PM Series
subtitle: Whole-house fresh-air inverter dehumidifier
model: FD-X28PM, FD-X40PM, FD-X60PM, FD-X80PM, FD-X100PM, FD-X140PM
bullets: Supply air 200 – 1,120 m³/h with up to 350 m³/h fresh air
G4 + H13 HEPA filtration, UV and anion purification

capacity.text: 25–145 L/day at 27 °C, 60% RH; 200–1,120 m³/h supply air

overview: The LUKO FD-X/PM series is a ducted whole-house dehumidifier that also brings in filtered fresh air. Outdoor air is mixed with indoor return air, dried by an inverter refrigerant circuit and delivered to every room through the filter module, lowering humidity while raising indoor oxygen levels. An absolute-humidity sensor targets moisture content, not just a percentage, for accurate control. It is a patented design by the manufacturer. Cosmix Engineering supplies, installs and supports the FD-X/PM series in homes and villas across Pakistan.

features.title: Inverter compressor and EC fan
features.text: Inverter compressor and variable-speed EC fan adjust output to the real moisture load for quiet, energy-saving operation.

features.title: Fresh air with clean filtration
features.text: Brings in up to 350 m³/h of fresh air through a G4 primary filter and H13 HEPA filter, with a UV sanitiser and anion generator.

features.title: 5-in-1 air quality sensor
features.text: Reads CO₂, PM2.5, TVOC, humidity and temperature in real time and switches modes automatically.

features.title: App control and OTA upgrades
features.text: App control, AI frequency adjustment and remote firmware upgrades keep the system up to date.

features.title: Easy service
features.text: Push-and-pull modules and positive-pressure drainage, with no condensate left in the tray, keep servicing quick and simple.

features.title: Whole-house ducted layout
features.text: One ceiling-concealed unit serves every room through supply ducts, with return and fresh air brought back to the unit. Typical locations are the entrance hall, balcony, AC unit space or bathroom ceiling.
